highlights.reason_zh: 故障续跑与 VM 暂存直接改变长任务恢复和不可信代码验收方式。
highlights.reason_en: Failover continuation and VM staging directly change long-task recovery and untrusted-code acceptance.

highlights.reason_zh: 完整 27B 长上下文模型进入 12 GB GPU 可测范围，但 fork-only runtime 是明确代价。
highlights.reason_en: A full long-context 27B model becomes testable on 12 GB GPUs, with a clear fork-only runtime cost.

highlights.reason_zh: 两组独立实测确认本地可跑，也暴露任务质量与失控 token 成本边界。
highlights.reason_en: Two independent tests confirm local execution while exposing task-quality and runaway-token cost limits.

highlights.reason_zh: 取消流费用与历史审计行决定网关能否完整追责。
highlights.reason_en: Cancelled-stream spend and historical audit rows determine whether gateway accountability remains complete.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并完成阅读；主动补充模型、工具、RAG、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、小团队与中文材料。Kintsugi-27B 是 overlap late-discovery；HF 全局仓库流无法证明穷尽覆盖。四项到期复核已完成，Inkling 获得独立证据。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and fully read. Active discovery covered models, tools, RAG, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, small teams and Chinese-language sources. Kintsugi-27B is an overlap late discovery; the global HF stream cannot prove exhaustive coverage. Four due reviews were completed, with independent evidence added for Inkling.
